# hyperlite_group (Resource)

A group of accounts: an assignment to it gives its rights to every member.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hyperlite_group" "ops" {
  name    = "ops"
  members = [hyperlite_user.ci.username]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Its name.

### Optional

- `members` (Set of String) Its members, by account name; when absent, the members are not managed here.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The group's id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By its id.
terraform import hyperlite_group.ops 2
```
